definitions.gloss: regular event, established custom, annual tradition
definitions.explanation: An event or practice that takes place regularly as an established tradition. Implies something that happens on a fixed schedule and has become customary.

examples.japanese: {恒例|こうれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夏祭|なつまつ}り→夏祭り：09871_natsumatsuri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれる→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: The annual summer festival will be held again this year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧{恒例|こうれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大掃除|おおそうじ}→大掃除：08347_oosouji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We did the year-end cleaning, as is customary.

examples.japanese: {恒例|こうれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行事|ぎょうじ}→行事：00078_gyouji⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{四月|しがつ}→四月：00668_shigatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{花見|はなみ}→お花見：17953_ohanami⟧⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開催|かいさい}している→開催する：10441_kaisaisuru⟧。
examples.english: As an established tradition, we hold a cherry blossom viewing party every April.

notes:
{恒例|こうれい} describes an event or practice that takes place regularly as an established tradition. Functions as a ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧-adjective.

FORMS:
{恒|こう} (constant, always) + ⟦{例|れい}→例：09932_rei⟧ (custom, precedent).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {恒例|こうれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行事|ぎょうじ}→行事：00078_gyouji⟧: regular/annual event
- ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧{恒例|こうれい}: year-end tradition
- ⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧{恒例|こうれい}: annual tradition
- {恒例|こうれい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧: has become a tradition
- {恒例|こうれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧: customary greeting

USAGE:
Very common in news reports and announcements about recurring events. Implies the event is well-established and expected. Often used with seasonal events: ⟦{花見|はなみ}→花見：01700_hanami⟧, ⟦{大掃除|おおそうじ}→大掃除：08347_oosouji⟧, ⟦{忘年会|ぼうねんかい}→忘年会：15800_bounenkai⟧, etc.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {恒例|こうれい}: established, recurring tradition (formal)
- ⟦{定例|ていれい}→定例：11502_teirei⟧: regular, fixed schedule (more systematic — ⟦{定例|ていれい}→定例：11502_teirei⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧, regular meeting)
- ⟦{慣例|かんれい}→慣例：12679_kanrei⟧: established custom, convention (more general)
